descriptionAdvanced.de: Lloyd Harbor bietet eine ruhige Flucht aus dem New Yorker Stadtleben. Das Kronjuwel ist der Caumsett State Historic Park Preserve Beach, der weite Wanderwege und unberührte Küstenabschnitte bietet. Familien genießen den West Neck Beach und den Lloyd Beach wegen ihres ruhigen Wassers am Huntington-Hafen. Weitere Küstenschönheiten sind der Fiddlers Green Beach und der Fort Hill Beach. Die Gegend ist geprägt von der Geschichte der Goldküste, insbesondere durch das Marshall Field III Anwesen. Kulinarisch profitiert der Ort von der Nähe zu Huntington, wo erstklassige Fischrestaurants und gemütliche Bistros den Fang des Tages servieren. Die Anreise erfolgt meist mit dem Auto über den Northern State Parkway.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Lloyd Harbor a nyugalom szigete New York közelében. A környék legfontosabb látnivalója a Caumsett State Historic Park Preserve Beach, amely hatalmas túraútvonalakkal és érintetlen tengerparttal várja a látogatókat. A családok körében népszerű a West Neck Beach és a Lloyd Beach a Huntington-öböl nyugodt vize miatt. A vízi sportok kedvelői gyakran látogatják a Fiddlers Green Beach és a Fort Hill Beach szakaszait is. A település történelme szorosan összefonódik az aranyparti korszak birtokaival. A helyi gasztronómia a friss osztrigára és tengeri halakra épül, amelyeket a szomszédos Huntington kikötőjében tálalnak a legkiválóbb minőségben. Megközelítése autóval a legpraktikusabb.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Lloyd Harbor oferă o evadare liniștită lângă New York. Bijuteria coroanei este Caumsett State Historic Park Preserve Beach, oferind trasee vaste și o coastă neatinsă. Familiile apreciază West Neck Beach și Lloyd Beach pentru apele lor calme din portul Huntington. Alte puncte de atracție includ Fiddlers Green Beach și Fort Hill Beach. Zona este definită de istoria epocii de aur, în special prin domeniul Marshall Field III. Gastronomia locală profită de proximitatea față de Huntington, unde restaurantele pescărești servesc capturi proaspete. Accesul se face în principal cu mașina prin Northern State Parkway, oferind o călătorie pitorească prin pădurile din Suffolk County.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Lloyd Harbor offers a serene escape on Long Island's Gold Coast. The centerpiece is the Caumsett State Historic Park Preserve Beach, featuring miles of trails and scenic waterfronts. Residents and visitors enjoy the calm waters of West Neck Beach and Lloyd Beach, ideal for kayaking. Other notable spots include Fiddlers Green Beach, Fort Hill Beach, and the private Lloyd Neck Estates Beach. The village is steeped in history, centered around the former estate of Marshall Field III. For dining, the nearby Huntington village offers sophisticated seafood and international cuisine. Accessibility is best by car, providing a secluded atmosphere that feels worlds away from the city while being just an hour from Manhattan.
